violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregiver in the infant classroom was not aware of the ages of the children in care and did not have record of each child's age available.

finding_variants.text: The caregiver in the infant classroom was not aware of the ages of the children in care and did not have record of each child's age available.
Based upon the information gathered during the investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support a child was left on the playground unattended.
Two caregivers in the toddler classrooms did not know an accurate age of children they were responsible for.

Based on information gathered through a DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not know the names of the children she was responsible for. A child was crying when two other children were on top of him. The caregiver did not know the names of the children involved and did not check the child for any injuries.

A caregiver did not know the ages of the children in care and did not have a list of names and ages posted. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver wrote and posted the children's ages on their name cards.

A caregiver with a group of children 14-21 months old was not aware of the ages of the children in their care. A caregiver with a group of children between 4-11 years old was not aware of the ages of the children in their care.
